title: Curriculum of one programme for one academic year (curriculum/YYYY-YYYY.json for undergraduate, curriculum/<programme-id>/YYYY-YYYY.json for postgraduate)

academic_year.description: Must match the file name. Example: 2026-2027

degree.description: What kind of programme this is: undergraduate (bachelor's) or postgraduate (master's, PhD and so on)

program.description: Only for postgraduate: the id of the programme, from postgraduate_programs.json. Leave out for undergraduate. Example: msc-data-science

requirements.description: What a student needs to graduate from this programme

total_ects.description: Total ECTS needed to graduate. Example: 240

min_semesters.description: Minimum number of semesters of study

rules.description: Each requirement, written as a short title and a plain sentence

ects_caps.description: Limits on how many ECTS a student may take

levels.description: Kinds of courses, such as mandatory, core elective, elective, free elective

short.description: Short label shown next to a course. Example: UP

code.description: The course code, exactly as the university prints it, but without spaces and without the characters : and /. Example: 3117

level.description: The id of the level (from the levels list above)

semesters.description: The study semester numbers the course is taught in. Example: [1] or [7, 8]

available_from.description: The earliest study semester a student may take the course, when that is earlier than the semester it is taught in. Example: 4. Leave out if it is the same.

cycles.description: Ids of the cycles this course belongs to (optional)

prerequisites.description: Courses a student should have passed first (optional). Example: ["1001", "mathematics:1002"]

instructors.description: The teachers, as ids from a faculty list (optional). Example: ["smith-john", "mathematics:euler-leo"]

instructor_names.description: Names of teachers who are in no faculty list, such as visiting or long-gone staff, each written per language (optional)

language.description: Language of teaching: en or el

active.description: Write false if the course is no longer offered. Leave out otherwise.
